s: Shiur kammut lishat hammatztzot ubo t' seipim: en lashin lepesach issa gedola mishshiur challa, dehaynu asirit haepa qemach, lepi shekkak shiaru chakamim, shehaeseq shehaadam mitasseq beyado baissa belisha vaarika eno matztzilah mide chimmutz keshehi gedola yoter meissaron, sheen hayyadayim maspiqot lehitasseq bah mittok godlah. Vaapillu im rotzeh lehitasseq bah kol kak bizrizut ad shemmittechillat hallisha ad haapiyya lo yihyeh shehut kede hilluk mil, venimtza sheap im lo haya mitasseq bah kelal hayeta mutteret, shebbepachot mikkede hilluk mil enah baa lide chimmutz, mikkol maqom kevan shellekattechilla asur lehashhot haissa apillu rega echad belo eseq, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"t, lepikak asur gam ken lalush lekattechilla yoter meissaron, shehare haeseq sheyyitasseq beissa zo — hare hu keillu eno, kevan sheeno moil kelum lehatztzil mechimmutz:

Vekamma hu issaron? Kemo m"g betzim vechomesh betza mibbetzim habbenoniyyot shel betzat tarnegolet. Veketzad yeshaarennu? Yiqqach keli gadol vimalleennu mayim al kol gedotayv viareh mimmennu hammayim letok keli acher reqan, veachar kak yitten m"g betzim betok hakkeli sheera mimmennu hammayim, veachar kak yachazor viareh letoko et hammayim ad sheyyihyeh male al kol gedotayv kebarishona, vehammayim shennisharu hen hen kemo m"g betzim, veyosip alehem od meat mayim kemo chomesh betza, veyiqqach keli vimalleennu bammayim hallalu, ukeli zeh hu issaron haamur battora. Vimalleennu qemach bepizzur kederek hammokerim, dehaynu shello yidchoq haqqemach betoko, sheaz hu machaziq yoter meissaron qemach, ella yaknisennu letoko berapuy, velo yigdosh haqqemach al gabbe hakkeli ella yemalleennu beshaveh im sepato kederek shemmille oto bammayim hallalu, shello haya bahem godesh:

Vetob letzamtzem beissaron zeh shehu moded bah qemach lepesach, velo yaasennu ella kemo m"g betzim o pachot. Veim moded haqqemach beissaron hammadud lechalla shehu machaziq issaron berevach — tob shello yemalleennu qetzat. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesherotzeh lalush b' issot o yoter, shehu yakol lehaprish challa kesheyyetzarep otan yachad al derek sheyyitbaer besiman tn"z, abal im eno rotzeh lalush ella issa achat, veim yetzamtzem bah haissaron lo yukal lehaprish mimmenna challa bibraka mechamat chashash beraka lebattala, veap im yetzamtzem bah kol kak ad shebbevadday lo yihyeh bah issaron utehe petura min hachalla — gam ken eno nakon, sheasur leadam laasot issato pachot meissaron bemitkavven kede lepotrah min hachalla kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shk"d, lepikak yesh lo limdod haissaron berevach kede sheyyukal lehaprish meissa zo bibraka beli shum sapeq, veen bah chashash chimmutz mechamat meat qemach shemmosip al haissaron keshemmodedo berevach:

Yesh lizzaher lekattechilla leachar shennatan haqqemach betok hammidda o betok haareba, shello yidchoq oto bayyadayim o bedabar acher, lepi shekkeshehaqqemach hu dachuq umequbbatz eno nillosh yapeh, sheen hammayim niknasin lesham yapeh venishar qetzat qemach betok haissa, vehu ba lide chimmutz kesheyyaasu tabshil mehaissa leachar apiyyatah:
Tob lizzaher shello lehanniach hayyad al haqqemach shello letzorek, shehayyad mechammemet qetzat, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"h:

Keshennoten haqqemach letok haareba o letok hammidda lelishat hammatztzot shel mitzva — tob sheyyomar bepiv sheoseh ken leshem matztza shel mitzva, veken yomar bishat netinat hammayim leqemach, ayyen besiman tn"h:

Yesh omerim shello aseru chakamim laasot issa gedola meissaron ella bizmannehem, shehattannurim shellahem hayu qetannim ubeqal mitztannenim, veyesh lachosh shemma yitztareku hammatztzot lishhot zeman arok betok hattannur o chutz lattannur veyabou lide chimmutz, abal battannurim shellanu shehem gedolim — en lachosh lazeh. Lepikak muttar lanu lalush issa gedola meissaron kepi mah sheyyesh bene adam haozerim betiqqun hammatztzot vaarikatam. Vetob hu lalush kol kak kede sheyyihyu kol haozerim kullam vekol hakkelim shebbidehem oseqim babbatzeq tamid, velo yachmitz habbatzeq haddabuq bidehem ubakkelim shebbidehem:

Veal sebara zo sameku haolam akshav shennahagu lalush harbeh yoter meissaron kepi sheyyesh bene adam haozerim, veen banu koach limchot beyadam, sheyyesh lahem al mah sheyyismoku. Abal kol adam yachamir al atzmo kassebara harishona ki ken iqqar, sheap im yesh lo harbeh ozerim betiqqun hammatztzot vaarikatam, vegam yesh lo harbeh tannurim gedolim nissoqim — sop sop bishat lishat haissa yesh chashash chimmutz, shehare ishsha achat lasha issa achat, veim haissa gedola meissaron — en yede haishsha maspiqot lehitasseq yapeh bekullah shello yetze chutz leyadah qetzat. Umikkol maqom, im abar velash issa gedola meissaron, apillu lash bemezid — mutteret baakila, veen liqnos al sheabar al dibre chakamim, kevan sheyyesh mattirin apillu lekattechilla. Veen lachosh shemma nitchammetza bishat hallisha, kevan shemmittechillat hallisha ad sheyyatchilu haozerim laarok hammatztzot en sham shehut kede hilluk mil, ubepachot mikkede hilluk mil ap im lo hayu mitasseqin bah kelal lo hayeta baa lide chimmutz ap al pi shehi gedola meissaron. Abal im haya sham shehut kede hilluk mil — tob lehachamir leatzmo shello leoklah bepesach im epshar lo:

Kesherotzeh lalush issa beyom tob — yesh lizzaher lekattechilla limdod haqqemach beissaron meereb yom tob, shebbeyom tob asur limdod apillu lidbar mitzva, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"v. Veim lo madad meereb yom tob — yiqqach issaron qemach beomed haddaat, velo yarbeh al issaron beomed dato mippene chashash chimmutz. Abal muttar lo lipchot meissaron, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tn"z. Umikkol maqom, yoter tob lalush haissa beb' peamim, dehaynu sheyyiqqach yoter mechatzi issaron veyalush mimmennu issa achat, veachar kak yachazor veyiqqach yoter mechatzi issaron qemach veyalush mimmennu od issa achat, vitzarep b' haissot yachad al derek sheyyitbaer besiman tn"z, veyaprish mehen challa. Ukeshehu oseh ken — ap lekattechilla en tzarik limdod haqqemach meereb yom tob:
